layers.message: Clarify export timestamps and combined filters in usage guide
Record final review finding on synchronization record
Complete CSV export final review rerun

graderOnly: The synchronization record is IN_PROGRESS because of an earlier Synchronizer Corrective Return. That return corrected the record's implementation-review basis (D-001, owner Synchronizer, RESOLVED), resumed the final review rerun at REVIEWING_FINAL, and stated that full synchronization was incomplete.

Reviewer independently reassessed the correction. The final-deliverable review is now COMPLETE, and its F-001 (owner Synchronizer) is RESOLVED. The review's assessed revision is the commit 'Correct synchronization comparison basis', and every identity it cites matches HEAD. Reviewer then handed FORWARD to SYNCHRONIZING.

Recovery frame 1 remains on the stack. It is the user's documentation rework at sign-off: From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING. SYNCHRONIZING is the rerun boundary.
Outstanding obligations are inactive and nothing is blocked.

Some identities in the synchronization record are stale. Since it was last written, the final-deliverable review and STATE.md changed. The usage-guide rework (docs/usage.md and the documentation record) changed before that write and has not yet been reconciled by Synchronizer.

All current acceptance and technical evidence (AC-001 to AC-003) holds for the current content. The rework's guide statements (createdAt written as stored in UTC; combined filters) are accurate. The other gates and completion requirements hold, and no new discrepancy exists.
Correct outcome: mark the synchronization record COMPLETE. Then, at the rerun boundary, pop frame 1 and RESUME to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with recovery inactive. Do not sign off.

vars.GUIDE_REWORK_COMMIT: ${COMMIT:Clarify export timestamps and combined filters in usage guide}

all.why: completing synchronization requires updating the synchronization record (its status and stale identities)
the record keeps its current-cycle provenance

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Synchronizer must not change git state
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its synchronization record and does not rewrite the deliverable or other roles' records

selfChecks.why: the SYNCHRONIZING rerun state with the rework frame active and the IN_PROGRESS synchronization record is valid
all work is committed and no export files exist

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FORWARD` `From`: `REVIEWING_FINAL` `FailureType`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -A2 '^## Recovery' .standards/STATE.md | grep -q 'Active`: `true`' && test $(grep -c '^### Frame' .standards/STATE.md) -eq 1 && grep -q '^`From`: `AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF` `Owner`: `DOCUMENTING` `FailureType`: `DOCUMENTATION`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`ResumeAt`: `AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF` `RerunThrough`: `SYNCHRONIZING`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -A2 '^## Outstanding Obligations' .standards/STATE.md | grep -q 'Active`: `false`' && grep -q '^`PromotionReason`: `NONE` `AuditTarget`: `NONE` `BlockedOn`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PendingVerificationCadence`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`BaselineReconciliation`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q 'ProjectMode`: `BROWNFIELD' .standards/MODE.md
selfChecks.why: STATE.md holds SYNCHRONIZING after Reviewer's forward handoff, with recovery active (one rework frame whose rerun runs through SYNCHRONIZING), obligations inactive, and nothing blocked

selfChecks.cmd: s=.standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && f=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/final-deliverable.md && d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && head -3 $s | grep -qx 'Artifact: SYNCHRONIZATION' && head -3 $s | grep -qx 'Cycle: export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2' && grep -q '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`$' $s && grep -q '^### D-001 ' $s && grep -q '`Status`: `RESOLVED`' $s && ! grep -q '`Status`: `OPEN`' $s && grep -q 'Synchronizer Corrective Return' $s && grep -q '^`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $f && grep -q '^### F-001 ' $f && grep -q '`Status`: `RESOLVED`' $f && ! grep -q '`Status`: `OPEN`' $f && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`$' $d && grep -q '^### DOC-001 ' $d && ! grep -q '`Status`: `OPEN`' $d
selfChecks.why: the synchronization record is IN_PROGRESS from the corrective return; the final review is COMPLETE with F-001 resolved; the documentation record is COMPLETE with the rework entry resolved

selfChecks.cmd: g=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Clarify export timestamps and combined filters in usage guide') && test $(git diff --name-only $g~1 $g) = docs/usage.md && d=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Update CSV export documentation record') && git diff --quiet $d HEAD -- src test packages docs README.md package.json .gitignore pnpm-lock.yaml AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md && b=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record CSV export final review') && git diff --quiet $b HEAD -- src test packages README.md package.json .gitignore pnpm-lock.yaml && c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Correct synchronization comparison basis') && test $(git diff --name-only $c HEAD | paste -s -d , -) = .standards/STATE.md,.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/final-deliverable.md
selfChecks.why: the rework changed only docs/usage.md; the deliverable is unchanged since the documentation record update; after the synchronization correction only the final review and STATE.md changed

selfChecks.cmd: s=.standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && f=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/final-deliverable.md && d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Correct synchronization comparison basis') $f && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:$s) $f && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:$d) $f && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:docs/usage.md) $f && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:docs/usage.md) $d && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Document CSV export in usage guide') $d && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:docs/usage.md) $s && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:src/export.ts) $s && ! grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:$f) $s && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD~1:$f) $s && ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs .standards/CONTEXT.md
selfChecks.why: the final review and documentation record cite the current identities; the synchronization record cites the current guide and source but the earlier, reopened final-review identity; no placeholders remain

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'status=archived&q=review' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'in UTC' docs/usage.md && node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `g-`)), `out`); const r = createApp({ exportDir: dir, now: () => new Date(`2026-09-24T09:00:00Z`) }).handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: { status: `archived`, q: `review` }, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); const rows = r.body.trimEnd().split(String.fromCharCode(13, 10)); if (r.status !== 201 || rows.length !== 2 || !rows[1].startsWith(`3,`) || !rows[1].endsWith(`,2026-04-01T08:05:00Z`)) { console.error(r); process.exit(1); } console.log(`combined filter export holds`); }, (e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(2); })'
selfChecks.why: the reworked guide statements are accurate: a combined status and q export returns the matching archived record, with createdAt written as the stored UTC value

selfChecks.cmd: git log -8 --format=%s | paste -s -d '|' - | grep -qx 'Complete CSV export final review rerun|Correct synchronization comparison basis|Record final review finding on synchronization record|Update CSV export documentation record|Clarify export timestamps and combined filters in usage guide|Record usage guide rework request|Record CSV export synchronization|Record CSV export final review'
selfChecks.why: the sign-off, rework, rerun, and correction route is committed in order on top of the base

notes:
Built on export-synchronizing. Seven commits add the history the case describes, arranged so that recovery is still active when Synchronizer runs.

50-sync-complete: Synchronizer's first pass writes a COMPLETE synchronization record and STATE moves to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. The record contains an ordinary reasoning error: it takes the plan's implementation commit as the implementation-review basis, and so narrows the AC-002 evidence.

52-rework: at sign-off the user asks for a guide rework (export timestamp zone and a combined-filter example). This is a USER_REWORK with FailureType DOCUMENTATION. It pushes Frame 1: From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF.

54-guide-rework: Documenter edits docs/usage.md. The new statements are accurate.

56-doc-record: the documentation record is updated (COMPLETE, DOC-001 RESOLVED). Frame 1 gets RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING, and the handoff is FORWARD to REVIEWING_FINAL.

58-review-finding: Reviewer's rerun reopens the final review (IN_PROGRESS) and records F-001 against the synchronization record's basis. This is a FAILURE SYNCHRONIZATION and pushes nested Frame 2 (ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL).

60-sync-correction: Synchronizer corrects the basis (D-001, owner Synchronizer, RESOLVED) and reopens the record as IN_PROGRESS. It records a Synchronizer Corrective Return stating that full synchronization is incomplete, pops Frame 2, and hands off with RESUME to REVIEWING_FINAL.

62-final-review: Reviewer resolves F-001 and completes the final review against current content. Frame 1 stays (RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING) and the handoff is FORWARD to SYNCHRONIZING.

Recovery is therefore active at SYNCHRONIZING, which is the rerun boundary. Passing the full gate then pops Frame 1 and resumes at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, matching the expected outcome. The synchronization record's final-review identity is stale, and it has not reconciled the guide rework.
